caption: The drawing depicts a single, oval-shaped plate set centrally on a plain, off-white or light beige background. The plate itself is illustrated with faint blue linework and shading, with a landscape scene consisting of trees, a bridge, and a body of water rendered inside the plate using light blue tones near the top and bottom edges of the plate's interior. The rim of the plate is outlined in a thin gold or yellow line. Beneath the main plate, there is a smaller, simplified side profile sketch of the same plate, rendered in light gray, placed within a separate small rectangle. The drawing is bordered by a rectangular outline, and there is a small signature or name written in blue ink on the lower right of the primary rectangle. No other objects are present in the composition.
title: Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
